item.title: Texas court reopens Houston home ownership dispute after foreclosure and reverse mortgage
item.description: A Texas appeals court has reopened a lengthy dispute over home ownership in Houston, which has complicated legal issues. The case involves multiple foreclosures, reverse mortgages, and unclear ownership claims spanning twenty-five years. Key questions remain about the validity of a 2011 mortgage after a previous foreclosure occurred in 2001. This ruling requires lower courts to thoroughly examine competing ownership claims before making decisions. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Clínicas de alta tecnología y laboratorios especializados ofrecen tratamientos y programas para retrasar los efectos del envejecimiento. item.title: Endangered giant burrowing frog returns to wild after tadpoles rescued from ashes of black summer fires
item.description: Tadpoles collected from puddles in East Gippsland were transported to Melbourne zoo, where they were raised to metamorphosis and successfully bred in captivity for the first time After the 2019-20 black summer bushfires , scientists in eastern Victoria stumbled across something they had been after for years: puddles of tadpoles from the southern giant burrowing frog, one of the state’s most cryptic amphibians. The fires had torn through extensive areas in East Gippsland, sparking concerns for the survival of the frog, which is considered critically endangered in Victoria. Continue reading...
